cards.name: Volbeat
cards.description: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

cards.name: Illumise

attacks.name: Ire-Fly
attacks.effect: If Volbeat is in your discard pile, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.

cards.name: Snivy

attacks.name: Leaf Boomerang
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: Servine's one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.

cards.name: Serperior

abilities.name: Regal Bloom
abilities.effect: This Pokémon gets +30 HP for each [G] Energy attached to it.

attacks.name: Flog
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.description: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Magmar

attacks.name: Derisive Roasting
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon's body.

attacks.name: Heat Charged
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, produce a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Netherwing
attacks.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Houndour
cards.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Houndoom

attacks.name: Toxfire Fang
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Burned.

cards.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: Twigs make for Fennekin's snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: Braixen's branch ignites as it's pulled from the Pokémon's tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.

cards.name: Delphox

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Lapras

attacks.name: Ruthless Whirlpool
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has more Energy attached than your opponent's Active Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.description: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

attacks.name: Hailstorm
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin
cards.description: Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it's a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion

attacks.name: Soul Counter
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each point your opponent got during their last turn.

cards.description: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Voltorb
cards.description: It's usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Electrode

abilities.name: Destiny Burst
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 70 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.

attacks.name: Thunderclaw
attacks.effect: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Pincurchin

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.description: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Slowpoke

attacks.name: Scavenge
attacks.effect: Put a random Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

abilities.name: Evil Inspiration
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Hand Kinesis
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Drowzee
cards.description: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Hypno

attacks.name: Entrap
attacks.effect: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Mr. Mime
cards.description: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psychic Explosion
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself.

cards.description: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: Behind an Espurr's expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.

cards.name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Punch and Draw
attacks.effect: Draw a card.

cards.description: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.

cards.name: Gimmighoul
cards.description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

cards.name: Marowak

attacks.name: Punish
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has “Team Rocket” in its name, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

cards.name: Landorus

attacks.name: Gaia Impact
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Ekans
cards.description: A very common sight in grasslands and such. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Arbok

attacks.name: Shadow Seeker
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each Energy in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.description: This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets its prey, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far the prey goes.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Grimer

attacks.name: Sludge
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.description: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Muk

attacks.name: Poison Absorption
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Koffing

attacks.name: Reverse Thrust
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.

abilities.name: Boiler Smog
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Poisoned and Burned.

attacks.name: Confusion Gas
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Sneasel

attacks.name: Group Beatdown
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.description: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.description: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Tinkatink
cards.description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Tinkatuff
cards.description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Tinkaton

attacks.name: Pile-Driving Hammer
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 2 [C] more, and its Retreat Cost is 2 [C] more.

cards.description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

cards.name: Gholdengo

abilities.name: Luxury Coin
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you flip any coins for an effect of your Trainer cards, you may ignore all results of those coin flips and begin flipping those coins again. You can't use more than 1 Luxury Coin Ability each turn.

cards.description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

cards.name: Gible

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.description: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

cards.name: Gabite

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Garchomp

abilities.name: Mach Stealth
abilities.effect: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this Pokémon's attacks, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.description: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

cards.name: Archaludon

attacks.name: Protect Charge
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes -30 damage from attacks.

cards.description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.

cards.name: Regidrago

attacks.name: Draconic Slam
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does -100 damage.

cards.description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Rattata

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.description: With their strong capacity for survival, they can live in dirty places without concern. Left unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.

abilities.name: Thieving Incisors
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may move a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Meowth
cards.description: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Persian

attacks.name: Dangerous Rogue
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Kecleon

abilities.name: Spy Ops
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may look at a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Hit and Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.description: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can't make its belly pattern disappear, however.

cards.name: Happiny

attacks.name: Chubby Cheer
attacks.effect: During your next turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It's bothered by how curly its hair looks.

cards.name: Furfrou

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes -20 damage from attacks.

attacks.name: Continuous Steps
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

cards.name: Lechonk
cards.description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

cards.name: Oinkologne

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.description: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

cards.name: Team Rocket’s Thieving Machine
cards.effect: Put a random Item card, except any Team Rocket's Thieving Machine, from your opponent's discard pile into your hand.

cards.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 1 more.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

cards.name: Ninetales

attacks.name: Ember Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 9 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

cards.name: Seaking

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

cards.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.description: Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful.

cards.name: Polteageist

abilities.name: Refreshing Tea
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand into their deck. For each remaining point that your opponent needs to win, they draw a card.

cards.description: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

cards.name: Swellow

abilities.name: Repelling Wind
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may switch out your opponent's Active Basic Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

cards.description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

attacks.name: Crimson Dive
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Damaging Spark
attacks.effect: This attack also does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has damage on it.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.effect: When this Pokémon is first damaged by an attack after coming into play, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Heat-Up Crunch
attacks.effect: Until this Pokémon leaves the Active Spot, this Pokémon's Heat-Up Crunch attack does +30 damage. This effect stacks.
